title: Push notification when an order ships
summary: Send a push notification when an order ships, using the Notification Gateway and reacting to events from the Order Service.

provenance.quote: Send a push notification when an order ships. Use the Notification Gateway, and react to events from the Order Service.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A push notification is sent when an order ships.
Push notifications are delivered through the Notification Gateway.
The system reacts to events emitted by the Order Service.

ambiguities.question: Which Order Service event signals that an order has shipped (name and payload)?
Who receives the push notification (the customer who placed the order, or other recipients)?
What content should the push notification contain (for example order number, carrier, tracking link)?
How should the system behave if the Notification Gateway is unavailable or delivery fails (retry, drop, alert)?
How are duplicate or redelivered shipped events handled so a recipient is not notified more than once per shipment?
What if an order ships in multiple parts: one notification per shipment or one per order?
Are user notification preferences or opt-outs, and recipients without a registered push device, in scope?
